text: @inkwell customers are being charged a cent too much on bulk orders (10+ reams) in the order portal. Nadia has examples in #general. Can you find and fix it? The repo is `quillfeather/order-portal`.
On it. Reading `src/pricing` and the cart tests now.

tasks.title: Find where the discount is rounded
Do the money in integer cents

text: Found it. `applyBulkDiscount` rounds in floating-point dollars: 107.40 × 0.075 is 8.054999…, so the 7.5% discount rounds down to $8.05 and 12 reams come to $99.35 instead of $99.34. I'll do the money in integer cents and add tests around both tiers. The plan is in the canvas tab.

--- a/src/pricing/discount.ts
+++ b/src/pricing/discount.ts
@@ -3,6 +3,6 @@
-  const subtotal = order.reams * order.pricePerReam
-  const discount = subtotal * tierRate(order.reams)
-  return Math.round((subtotal - discount) * 100) / 100
+  const subtotalCents = order.reams * toCents(order.pricePerReam)
+  const discountCents = roundHalfUp(subtotalCents * tierRate(order.reams))
+  return (subtotalCents - discountCents) / 100

-  const subtotal = order.reams * order.pricePerReam
-  const discount = subtotal * tierRate(order.reams)
-  return Math.round((subtotal - discount) * 100) / 100
+  const subtotalCents = order.reams * toCents(order.pricePerReam)
+  const discountCents = roundHalfUp(subtotalCents * tierRate(order.reams))
+  return (subtotalCents - discountCents) / 100
